title: Instant Chocolate Hard Shell
description: Instant chocolate hard shell for topping ice cream is deliciously crunchy and easy to make using 2 simple ingredients: chocolate and coconut oil.

steps.text: Combine chocolate chips and coconut oil in a microwave-safe bowl; heat in the microwave in 30-second intervals, mixing well each time, until mixture is smooth, 1 to 2 minutes. It takes about 1 minute of stirring until they fully mix together. Store at room temperature in an airtight container.

video.description: When an ice cream craving hits, the last thing you want to do is delay. This video shows you how to make magic shell with two simple ingredients–chocolate chips and coconut oil–in just five minutes. Save a trip to the store and enjoy this nostalgic chocolate ice cream topping at home instead! After all, what’s more magical than watching smooth chocolate transform into a hard candy shell right before your eyes? Your inner child will thank you for this homemade magic shell recipe.
